subtitles.sub: “Beneath the crimson blood moon, every oath is tested...”
♪ Opening Theme — Silhouette of Scarlet Dawn ♪
♪ Breaking through the shadows, we carry the flame forward ♪
subtitles.dub: ♪ Breaking through the shadows, our resolve never fades ♪

subtitles.sub: “You came all this way alone? The night belongs to us now.”
subtitles.dub: “You came all this way by yourself? Then witness the night.”

subtitles.sub: “I made a promise I intend to keep — no matter the cost.”
subtitles.dub: “I swore I would protect them, even if it takes everything I have.”

subtitles.sub: “Then draw your blade... and show me the strength of your resolve!”
subtitles.dub: “Show me what your conviction is really worth!”
